notes: SOURCE: manmade lake in Level 10 ~40 km from Malt Town; radioactive, toxic, carnivorous liquid from melted Object 24 masks that seeks the nearest living animal; murky crimson (was black); central black area darker than Vantablack; plants unharmed (grass on banks, algae/trichodesmium); 7 Sv/h; adjacent >1 h fatal; three stages within 10/30/60 min, even through a suit; deadly 1 cm inside the zone, absent outside; barbed-wire fence + warning signs (10 Aug 2021); entrants considered deceased; nuclear waste barrels and the dump; undocumented level under the depression (never an exit); Geiger sample in the page credits; high winds. ADAPTATION: lake ~350 m across (page 0.8 cubic miles) in a grass basin ~12 m below the Level 10 plain; fence ring on the rim 86 m from the water; gate, M.E.G. notice board, Geiger counter left on the board, abandoned barrels and crates at the dump point, a cut fence section; the 'seeking' is one slow swell that follows the player along the shore and kills on reaching them; walking 146 m out from the water on any bearing fires L010_1>L010#2 (a single walk-in band that follows your bearing); exposure persists inside this level only (the clock does not travel to Level 10: core has no carried-status API); stage effects are captions, desaturation, vignette, red tint and a blackout, never gore. Wheat beyond the verge and the tree lines on plot boundaries continue Level 10. Seed varies field stones, barrel placement and the swell's start. QA: no damage in QA mode; the exit band is 42 m behind the start.
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE (only the substance itself). The liquid's 'seeking' is a swell on the surface, never a creature. Gluffs/undocumented wanderers (RUMORED) are not shown.
